decision.reasoning_trace: In this shopping session, I evaluated several backpacks ranging from tactical and high-capacity hiking packs to premium ultralight models. While the KAILAS 28L (prod_backpacks_043) was described as a high-quality 'dupe' for premium brands, I noticed that all of its reviews were unverified, which raises concerns about the reliability of the high rating. The Osprey Exos (prod_backpacks_003) is a top-tier brand, but recent reviews noted a decline in suspension quality despite the high price. Other options like the Mardingtop and W WINTMING had specific feedback about hardware failures (broken buckles) and poor material durability. Given the combination of high prices for questionable durability or low-trust reviews, I have decided not to make a purchase at this time.
